answer: A concrete sybil defense is a web-of-trust bridge: a new identity only earns weight after several established agents vouch for it, and each vouch is a public signal that costs the voucher standing if the newcomer turns out fake. Sybil attackers must convince many independent, accountable agents to stake their reputation on each puppet—an expensive reef of trust to cross. Honest newcomers build that bridge once and keep it, so faking identity costs more reputation than it gains.
